_about: Hand-kept runtime rows that are not in the probe registry (tools/build_registry.py appends them; enabled is decided by the same rule as every other row). The EviMed API scans of plan 12.2: request shapes as measured on 2026-09-22 (tools/evimed_api_freshness.py in the plan's assets): 20 ChiCTR terms, 30 guideline publisher groups. The key is injected by the fetcher from KNOWLEDGE_PLUGIN_EVIMED_API_KEY_FILE. evimed-evidence (flywheel F09, 2026-10-05): the platform's own feed of what its evidence may offer the frontier, read like any other publisher's; its address is the deployment's (config.url_env, EVIMED_EVIDENCE_FEED_URL) and unset, the source loads disabled and nothing is polled. The ai-discovery-* rows (循证进化 breadth, 2026-10-10) are the sources the weekly self-research reads and the medical feed drops (config.discovery_only; the platform recognises the id prefix): three arXiv phrase rows over the core AI categories, the arXiv venue-accepted row, Hugging Face Daily Papers / model releases / blog, the Anthropic research mirror, the GitHub releases of 17 agent frameworks and the kernel's upstream (REST, not releases.atom: github.com's robots.txt disallows *.atom), PMLR volumes and the ACL Anthology's ingestion commits. The Hugging Face rows are relay (huggingface.co is unreachable from the Beijing host) and load disabled with relay_not_accepted until the Tokyo node has read them with the honest identity; every row was run once through `python -m knowledge_plugin.probe` on 2026-10-10 (registry/research/probe-ai-discovery-2026-10-10.jsonl), from the dev box, which is not a production vantage. ct-src 2026-10-24: six NMPA lists read through the browser exit with the selectors every NMPA list shares (div.list ul li, a@title, a@href, span) — the daily delivery notices of drug and device approval documents (each notice's page is the day's table of approvals: 受理号, 药品名称, 申请人, 批准文号), the drug and device regulatory work columns (where 「批准…上市」 is announced), device recalls and consultations; recorded as browser-list replay cases under tests/fixtures/browser-list/. c5-sources 2026-10-26: 73 rows — provincial drug regulators (15 provinces), European national medicine regulators, university and medical-school newsrooms and deals-and-financing media — each read once with the plugin's own adapters (validate_row, validate_config, a live parse under a browser and under the honest identity, robots.txt) and recorded in registry/research/source-expansion-2026-10-26.json; each is switched on by an overrides.json enabled with its reason (launch tier P2 as the research proposed them).
